header.name: Vantage
header.description: Vantage is a lightweight, compatibility-focused dynamic first-person add-on for Minecraft Bedrock. Adds full, native-feeling animations, customizable camera positioning, body visibility, FOV support, crawling, swimming, sneaking, riding, and more. V0.1.0-alpha.1, By Draco12191712 (Vivaan Bobade).
